categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: 3C components including optical and optical communication components; 3C retail and peripheral products such as Apple products and charging accessories; system and peripheral products including various scanners and automatic feeding modules; and energy services focusing on power plant development and clean energy services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-precision optical plastic components and lenses, advanced optical design and coating, precision mold manufacturing, automated production processes, and embedded intelligent image recognition for scanners. The energy segment involves engineering, construction, and operation of renewable energy power plants, including solar, wind, and hydropower, with integrated project management and maintenance capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are international brand manufacturers, distributors, and end-users in consumer electronics, telecommunications, data centers, and renewable energy sectors. The 3C components serve data centers, telecom networks, AI computing, and consumer devices. The retail segment targets consumers of Apple and related electronic products. Energy services cater to industrial, governmental, and utility clients involved in clean energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s key markets include Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, the United States, and other regions. Taiwan accounts for the majority of sales, followed by significant business in Hong Kong and China. The company also explores opportunities in Southeast Asia and other international markets for energy investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment, integrating upstream raw materials and components into finished optical and electronic products, and downstream distribution through retail channels. In energy, it covers upstream development, engineering, construction, and downstream operation and maintenance of power plants, providing end-to-end energy solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on clean energy and carbon reduction, advancing high-resolution and miniaturized optical components for 3C products, and developing high-speed optical communication modules. R&D emphasizes optical design, mold technology, automated manufacturing, and embedded intelligent imaging. The company also invests in renewable energy technologies and integrated energy service platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of optical components, 3C retail products, and system peripherals, as well as engineering contracts and operational income from energy services including power plant development, construction, and electricity sales. The company also benefits from licensing and service fees related to energy management platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In optical components, competitors include major manufacturers from China, Taiwan, and Korea, with the company holding a smaller market share but focusing on high-precision and specialized products. In 3C retail, competition is intense with many brands, but the company leverages strong Apple product distribution and supply chain advantages. In energy, competition is growing due to policy support, with the company positioned as a comprehensive clean energy service provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$26.9 billion in 2024, a 54.4% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company nearly doubling to NT$1.12 billion. Total assets grew by over 50% to NT$66.9 billion, and equity increased by 19.4%. The company shows strong growth driven by energy services and system products expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision optical and optical communication components with advanced manufacturing and design capabilities, integrated one-stop energy solutions covering development to operation, and a diversified product portfolio including Apple-certified 3C peripherals. Its competitive edge lies in vertical integration, strong R&D, quality assurance, and comprehensive energy service platforms aligned with sustainability goals.
